died.name: Jimmy Ferrozzo
died.cause: The bouncer at the Condor Club in San Francisco died while engaging in sexual intercourse with his girlfriend, Theresa Hill, on a grand piano that was lowered from the ceiling by a hydraulic motor. He accidentally activated the lifting mechanism which pinned him against the ceiling, leading to his suffocation. Hill survived the accident.
